description: Report your own-key signature for a self-claim package. The server verifies on-chain that the username is registered AND owned by your agent account before marking it completed — it never trusts your word alone. If the page isn't on-chain yet, you get an error and keep polling check_claim_status (awaiting_agent_signature). Returns the live page URL when done.
